scores.label: A
scores.note: Option 1 'meaningless' is usable but slightly shifts the meaning toward his feeling meaningless. Option 2 'void': 'how void he feels' is not idiomatic, and as an adjective 'void' means invalid. Option 4 'barren' carries the wrong sense (infertile) and is odd for a feeling. Option 5 'devoid' needs 'of', so it is ungrammatical here. Option 6 'painless' has the wrong meaning. Option 7 'insignificant' changes the meaning from inner emptiness to feeling unimportant. Option 9 'lifelessness' is a noun, so it is ungrammatical here. Option 10 'void of substance' is awkward and off-meaning for a feeling. Several options repeat the same 'void' and 'lifeless' stems.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Option 2 'dim' has the wrong meaning (dull or stupid). Option 4 'certain' has the wrong meaning. Option 5 'worthless' changes the meaning to low self-worth. Option 6 'naked' has the wrong sense. Option 7 'faded' is off-meaning and odd for a feeling. Option 9 'untrue' has the wrong meaning. Option 10 'perishable' has the wrong meaning. Of the top three, only option 3 'hopeless' is usable; 'desolate', the best pick, is buried at position 8.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Option 1 'void': 'how void he feels' is not idiomatic, and as an adjective 'void' means invalid. The rest of the list alternates echoes and duplicates.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Option 4 'useless' changes the meaning. Option 5 'unfulfilling' reverses who the word describes: it would mean he fails to fulfil others. Option 6 'unreal' has the wrong meaning. Option 8 'unimportant' changes the meaning to insignificance. Option 9 'devoid' needs 'of', so it is ungrammatical here. Option 10 'insignificant' changes the meaning to feeling unimportant.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Option 3 'void': 'how void he feels' is not idiomatic. Option 4 'vacuous' has the wrong sense (mindless or stupid). Option 5 'worthless' changes the meaning to low self-worth. Option 7 'insignificant' changes the meaning to feeling unimportant. Option 8 'devoid' needs 'of', so it is ungrammatical here. Option 9 'fruitless' describes efforts, not a feeling, so it is odd here. The best pick, 'hollow', is correctly placed first.
